scope: Actual same-codepoint CJK characters declared in every fixed Chinese sample, including both actual Simplified and Traditional forms and device-specific text. Original candidate pixels crop outer blank rows/columns only. No rescaling or internal edits.
method: Conservative full-image exact pixel search of each same-codepoint candidate glyph, without required blank border. Searching all image positions cannot miss a same-codepoint exact occurrence because of segmentation or layout. A hit alone is NOT claimed as a same-codepoint match until its placement is reviewed; no hits safely exclude exact matching for that tested glyph.
limitation: Fixed samples only, not complete-font deduplication. No inference about characters not in current PNG samples. Missing candidate glyphs are untestable, not mismatches. Pattern hits may occur at another codepoint or inside a larger glyph and must be reviewed. Different samples cannot prove independent authorship.
